products.name: Seats with wooden frames, and their wooden parts

links.quote: Roundwood that will be used as fuel…and wood that will be used for the production of charcoal

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood fuel includes roundwood that will be used for the production of charcoal.

links.quote: WOOD CHIPS, PARTICLES AND RESIDUES…It is the volume of roundwood that is left over after the production of forest products in the wood processing industry

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood chips, particles, and residues represent the volume of roundwood left over after the production of forest products.

links.quote: wood residues that will be used for production of pellets

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood residues include those used for the production of pellets.

links.quote: wood residues that will be used for production of pellets, other agglomerated products

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood residues include those used for the production of other agglomerated products.

links.quote: Wood that has been produced from both domestic and imported roundwood, either by sawing lengthways or by a profile-chipping process

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that sawnwood is produced from roundwood by sawing or profile-chipping.

links.quote: Roundwood that will be sawn (or chipped) lengthways for the manufacture of sawnwood or railway sleepers (ties) or used for the production of veneer

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that sawlogs and veneer logs are roundwood used for the production of veneer.

links.quote: Wood sawn or chipped lengthwise…and continuously shaped

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that further processed sawnwood is sawnwood that is continuously shaped.

links.quote: Roundwood that will be used for the production of pulp, particle board, oriented strand board (OSB) or fibreboard.

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that pulpwood is roundwood used for the production of particle board.

links.quote: A panel manufactured from small pieces of wood or other ligno-cellulosic materials (e.g. chips, flakes, splinters, strands, shreds, shives, etc.) bonded together

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that particle board is manufactured from small pieces of wood such as chips and flakes.

links.quote: Roundwood that will be used for the production of pulp, particle board, oriented strand board (OSB) or fibreboard.

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that pulpwood is roundwood used for the production of fibreboard.

links.quote: A panel consisting of an assembly of veneer sheets bonded together with the direction of the grain in alternate plies generally at right angles.

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that plywood consists of an assembly of veneer sheets bonded together.

links.quote: plywood with a solid core…consists of narrow boards, blocks or strips of wood placed side by side

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that core plywood or blockboard consists of a solid core of narrow boards, blocks, or strips of wood, which are forms of sawnwood.

links.quote: Roundwood that will be used for the production of pulp

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that pulpwood is roundwood used for the production of pulp.

links.quote: Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood pulp is prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles, or residues.

links.quote: Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process for further manufacture into paper, paperboard

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood pulp is used for the further manufacture of paper and paperboard.

links.quote: wood boards used to make “glulam” beams

aiCheck.note: The CBP ruling confirms that wood boards (sawnwood) are used to make glulam beams, which are classified as builders' joinery.

links.quote: Seats with wooden frames

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wooden furniture includes seats with wooden frames, which are typically made from sawnwood.

links.quote: Supplied timber may be considered as a component material but be later sawn and treated to be converted into a component part.

aiCheck.note: The EU Ecolabel criteria for furniture state that supplied timber (sawnwood) can be converted into component parts for furniture.

links.quote: Prefabricated buildings with wooden structure, exterior walls, floor and other characteristic constructive elements consisting essentially of wood.

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that prefabricated buildings of wood have structures and elements consisting essentially of wood (sawnwood).

links.quote: Subject merchandise includes wooden cabinets and vanities with or without wood veneers

aiCheck.note: The U.S. Commerce scope for wooden cabinets states that they include cabinets with or without wood veneers.

links.quote: It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings and trimmings

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood residues include wood waste and scrap from sawmilling, such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings, and trimmings.

links.quote: It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as…veneer log cores, veneer rejects

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood residues include veneer log cores and veneer rejects from veneer production.

links.quote: made substantially of wood products, including solid wood and engineered wood products…such as plywood

aiCheck.note: The U.S. Commerce scope for wooden cabinets states that they are made of wood products, including engineered wood products such as plywood.

links.quote: made substantially of wood products, including solid wood and engineered wood products…such as plywood, strand board, block board, particle board

aiCheck.note: The U.S. Commerce scope for wooden cabinets states that they are made of wood products, including engineered wood products such as particle board.

links.quote: made substantially of wood products, including solid wood and engineered wood products…such as plywood, strand board, block board, particle board, or fiberboard

aiCheck.note: The U.S. Commerce scope for wooden cabinets states that they are made of wood products, including engineered wood products such as fiberboard.

links.quote: BUILDER’S JOINERY AND CARPENTRY OF WOOD…cellular wood panels (also called cellular board which is plywood with a core of cellular construction)

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that builders' joinery includes cellular wood panels, which are defined as plywood with a core of cellular construction.

links.quote: Wood veneer floor covering means rigid floor covering consisting of a substrate made from a wood-based panel, with a top layer of wood veneer

aiCheck.note: The EU Ecolabel criteria for floor coverings state that wood veneer floor coverings (a type of joinery) consist of a substrate with a top layer of wood veneer.

links.quote: Wood that has been reduced to small pieces and is suitable for pulping, for particle board and/or fibreboard production

aiCheck.note: The JFSQ definitions state that wood chips and particles are suitable for fibreboard production.

links.quote: Laminate floorings…manufacturing of the core board

aiCheck.note: The EU Ecolabel criteria for floor coverings indicate that laminate floorings (a type of joinery) involve the manufacturing of a core board, which is typically made of fibreboard.
